candidates.transition_rationale: When o_dspi_mod is IDLE (0), the pipe request r_pipe_req should remain deasserted. The transition for state2002 forces it to 0 when clk_ctr equals 1, and no write-condition in IDLE triggers a new request.
candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: Avoids (=> (= state2002 1) (= state1536 0)) (reverse), (=> (= state1536 15) (= state2002 1)), and (not (and (= state1536 15) (= state2002 0))); all involve state1536 with other values or reversed roles.
candidates.why_consistent_with_reachable_samples: Init sample has state1536=0 and state2002=0. No reachable sample shows state1536=0 and state2002=1. Sample with state1536_next=0 and state1558_next=1 omits state2002, so no conflict.
candidates.why_nontrivial: Not a bitwidth tautology; expresses a functional dependency between mode IDLE and request state.

candidates.transition_rationale: Mode 10 requires cfg_mode=1. The configuration writes set both o_dspi_mod and cfg_mode from the same bus transfer, and the mode update logic ensures mode 10 is only reached when cfg_mode is 1.
candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: Avoids (=> (= state1536 10) (= state790 0)) and other falsified implications; none involve state79 with mode 10.
candidates.why_consistent_with_reachable_samples: Reachable sample state1536_next=10, state79_next=1 supports this. No sample shows state1536=10 and state79=0.
candidates.why_nontrivial: Not a bitwidth tautology; links a specific mode value to a control bit strength condition.

candidates.transition_rationale: Mode 15 (likely quad-SPI) may inherently dictate maximum speed, disabling the cfg_speed override. The transition function either ignores i_wb_data[10] in this mode or forces cfg_speed to 0 to avoid protocol conflict.
candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: Avoids (=> (= state1536 15) (= state2002 1)) and (not (and (= state1536 15) (= state2002 0))); those involve state2002, not state1558.
candidates.why_consistent_with_reachable_samples: No reachable sample captures state1536=15 together with state1558, so no contradiction. Init has state1536=0, not applicable.
candidates.why_nontrivial: Not a bitwidth tautology; expresses a mode-dependent restriction on the speed configuration bit.
